scientific_record_correction.explanation: The 16 development challenges are deterministic unit-test fixtures designed during development. Computing a p-value (e.g. p < 0.001) conflates deterministic test verification with population-level statistical inference. Scores are descriptive measures of algorithmic feature presence, not empirical emergence.
scientific_record_correction.emergence_vs_algorithm: Algorithmic capabilities (monotone LFP, cycle detection, acquisition deduplication, cascading invalidation) are deterministic computational procedures, not emergent scientific properties.

null_hypothesis_evaluation.null_hypothesis: Manifest's observed research capability can be reproduced by a competently equipped union of its constituent methods.

null_hypothesis_evaluation.scientific_interpretation: When the union comparator is competently equipped with identical algorithmic procedures (least-fixed-point reasoning, cycle detection, acquisition deduplication, and cascading invalidation), it achieves 16/16 (100%), matching Manifest exactly. The performance delta previously claimed (+6, p < 0.001) was an artifact of an asymmetric comparator lacking standard graph/logic algorithms, rather than evidence of emergent scientific behavior resulting from reciprocal interaction.
